variants_high: I will remember you. I will still mend your net.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.n1-4
words: Late for nets. Come in anyway.
variants_low: Lamps are lit. The rope is wet.
variants_high: Late for nets. Sit down. I will tell you a price.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.n1-4
words: You came back. The rack is yours to look over.
variants_low: Back, then. Mind the rack.
variants_high: You came back. Look the rack over. It is yours.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.n1
words: Mind the wet racks, traveller.
variants_low: Round the racks. I am counting.
variants_high: Traveller. Come round by the dry rack.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.n1
words: Off our yard, thief. Tideline's behind you.
variants_low: Off our yard.
variants_high: Off our yard, thief. Count what you took.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.n1
words: Late for the track, traveller. The stable door is barred.
variants_low: Too late. The door is barred.
variants_high: Late, traveller. The door is barred, but I will walk you to the track.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.n1
words: Dry rope today, traveller.
variants_low: Rope is drying. Go round.
variants_high: Dry rope today, traveller. Sit if you want.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.n2
words: This week's lots, each with its ship.
variants_low: Lots are on the board. Buy or leave.
variants_high: Welcome back. This week's lots, each with its ship.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.n2
words: No more buying from my stall.
variants_low: Not from my stall. Leave, ojel.
variants_high: I will not sell to you. Come back after you settle it.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.n2
words: Night buyer? The lamp is lit.
variants_low: Night buyer? Then say what you want.
variants_high: Night buyer? The lamp is lit. Come to the counter.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.n2
words: Good to see you. Fresh lots on the board.
variants_low: Fresh lots. Pick one.
variants_high: Good to see you. Fresh lots on the board, one held back.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.station-keeper
words: The office is open, traveller.
variants_low: Stage business only, traveller.
variants_high: Come and sit, traveller.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.station-keeper
words: That's going in the ledger.
variants_low: Entered. Don't expect it struck.
variants_high: Entered, though I've entered worse.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.station-keeper
words: The lamp's lit all night, traveller.
variants_low: The lamp's lit. Speak low.
variants_high: The lamp's lit, traveller. Warm yourself.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.chasepoint.station-keeper
words: You've a chair here, traveller.
variants_low: The chair's there, if you want it.
variants_high: Your chair's kept for you, traveller.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: Cart, or only feet? Water keep you.
variants_low: Feet or cart. Choose.
variants_high: Cart or feet? Water keep you, friend.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: Off my landing.
variants_low: Off, now.
variants_high: Saw that. This once I will say nothing.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: Back again. The raft is ready.
variants_low: Back again.
variants_high: You return. I have kept the raft ready for you.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: Dark water tonight. Step lightly.
variants_low: Black water. Go carefully.
variants_high: Dark water tonight. Mind the planks.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n1-2
words: Dried fish, if you are buying. Stay moist, traveller.
variants_low: Buying or not? The racks are not a bench.
variants_high: Sunned and warm, traveller. Fresh strings are up.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n1-2
words: I have written down what you did, stranger.
variants_low: It is written down. Keep from my racks.
variants_high: It is written down, stranger. Mend it and I will cross it out.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n1-2
words: The racks are full today.
variants_low: Racks are full. Nothing for you.
variants_high: The racks are full today. Take the best string.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n1-2
words: Racks covered. Come at dawn.
variants_low: Racks are covered. Be gone.
variants_high: Racks are covered. I will set a string aside.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n1-3
words: Bucket by the door. Go round it.
variants_low: Go round the bucket.
variants_high: Have a cup from the bucket.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n1-3
words: Get away from my door.
variants_low: Away from my door.
variants_high: Away from my door.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n1-3
words: Drink from my bucket. It runs cold.
variants_low: The bucket is full. Drink.
variants_high: Drink from my bucket, traveller. It runs cold today.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n1-3
words: Dark on the ford now. Go slowly over the stones.
variants_low: Dark ford. Go slowly.
variants_high: Dark on the ford. Rest here, then go over the stones.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n1
words: Supper's nearly ready, citizen.
variants_low: Supper's mine. Stand back.
variants_high: Sit down, citizen. There's enough in the pot.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n1
words: The well-keeper will hear of this.
variants_low: Seen it. She'll hear.
variants_high: I saw it, citizen. Put it right before she hears.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n1
words: Bowl's still warm for you, citizen.
variants_low: Bowl's gone. Off with you.
variants_high: Bowl's warm, citizen. The bread's fresh. Pull up a crate.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n1
words: Pot's off the fire. Come at sunrise.
variants_low: Pot's off. Come back at sunrise.
variants_high: Pot's off, citizen, but there's bread. Sunrise for more.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n2-2
words: You come from the Gideon road, sir?
variants_low: Not from Gideon, then. Go your way.
variants_high: Sir, you came at the right time. What news of Gideon?

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n2-2
words: That was a crime, sir.
variants_low: I watched you do it. Do it far from my sight.
variants_high: That was a crime, sir. Put it right before Gideon.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n2-2
words: Good, sir. I hoped you would pass again.
variants_low: Back already. I hoped for a better face.
variants_high: Sir, you are back. Sit and tell me of the road.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n2-2
words: Any word of the Gideon road tonight?
variants_low: Ask me of the road in daylight.
variants_high: Sit down, sir. What is said of Gideon tonight?

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n2
words: What does walker want of Abhuki?
variants_low: Walker talks too much. This one is busy.
variants_high: Ah, walker. Come, ask this one.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n2
words: Walker should not have done that. Abhuki has heard.
variants_low: Abhuki saw it. Walker had best go.
variants_high: Abhuki saw, walker. Do not do it again.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n2
words: Sit, walker. The brazier has room.
variants_low: Walker may stand.
variants_high: Sit, friend. The warm side is yours.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.n2
words: Awake too, walker? The coals are still warm.
variants_low: Walker should be asleep. This one is.
variants_high: Come sit, walker. The brazier has coals yet.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.well-keeper
words: Water or a bed, citizen?
variants_low: Water or a bed? Make up your mind.
variants_high: Water or a bed, citizen? The first bucket is on me.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.well-keeper
words: The log has this.
variants_low: Enough. It goes in the log.
variants_high: Stop there. Put it right and the log can wait.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.well-keeper
words: A friend of the office. A bed is made up for you.
variants_low: Friend of the office? Beds cost the same.
variants_high: A friend of the office. Your bed is made up. First bucket is mine.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.well-keeper
words: Awake at this hour? State your business, citizen.
variants_low: State your business or leave.
variants_high: Come in out of the dark, citizen. Your bed is aired.

words: Show your licence, citizen.
The Wardens are watching you.
Your customs mark is good, citizen.
Quiet at the border tonight, citizen.
Night patrol. Which road brought you here?
Lost, fresh meat? Gate's behind you.
Step out of line again and you lose a hand.
The east wall is yours tonight, brother.
East wall's short a spear, brother.
At the gate at night? The archers are awake.
Be welcome among the Bright-Throats, guest.
The chimes are off for you. Go.
Back in good time, guest. Was the water kind?
The fish is cooked, guest. There is plenty.
The chime-makers are working late on the frames.
Here to help, or here to count us?
Holders pay people like you.
Did the debt-roll come with you, sibling?
Bones go to the grove at dawn.
Hold the lamp. I am copying.
Your seal, colleague? I have to see it.
Every word of this goes to the Rector.
The survey copy came back marked, colleague.
I am busy tonight, colleague.
Do not breathe on the samples.
Chapter business, or just looking?
You took what is catalogued. Return it.
Good timing as ever, chapter-agent.
The crates are half open, agent.
The finds are locked away for the night.
Who let you through the gate?
You will answer to the House for that.
Your room is aired, muthsera.
The claim papers are in the press, serjo.
No callers are taken after dark.
This stretch is patrolled, civilian.
In the name of the Legion, halt.
The serjeant said you might pass, civilian.
Walking to the post? Come with us.
Who goes there? Your name.
Ward business? The clerk is inside.
The clerk will have your name by noon.
Your seat by the window is free, delegate.
The ward count is tomorrow, delegate.
The tribes still give the word on ward land, delegate.
Are you here for the tree, root-kin?
No shelter here for a thief.
Be welcome here, root-kin.
The grove edge is watched tonight, root-kin.
A tree-minder sits with the Hist.
Looking for work, or for a blade?
We've been paid to bring in people like you.
Good to see you on the roll, blade.
We march before dawn, captain.
Night contract? Costs double.
You have the look of a soldier.
I have killed better than you. Leave.
Good to see you, comrade.
We drink tonight. Pull up a bench.
Old wounds ache worst in this wet.
Hunter? You walk like prey.
Poacher. Go. The others know of you.
Is the kill shared with you yet, hunter?
A wamasu was seen near the village.
Night hunt. Stay behind me, hunter.
Watch your step here, outsider.
Leave the dead water, cutpurse.
Many here know your face, outsider.
The moon is thin. Hunting weather, outsider.
The path is hard to see after dark.
You lost? This door is not for you.
You talked, water-rat. Expect a cold swim.
The fence crew wants a word, reed.
Work for you tonight, if you want it.
Dry feet. Talk quiet, reed.
All things turn, seeker. What brings you?
All things turn. The temple doors do not.
The priests asked after you, seeker.
The third sermon starts soon, seeker.
The temple is open at night as well.
Passenger fares are paid at the plank.
Off the boat. Off the dock.
Fair tide. Your berth is clear, pilot.
Need a crossing? I'll wake the pilot.
No boats leave till dawn.
The tree has no sap up this season.
We want no trouble from you, Reed-walker.
Be welcome among the roots, friend of the roots.
The sap-speakers are inside, friend of the roots.
A sap-speaker is asleep in there.
State your purpose, traveller.
You cut a marker. Leave this way.
Did you hold to the marked path, traveller?
The markers are fresh-cut, traveller.
The way is shut until morning.
Who asked you aboard, then?
Over the side with you, landsman.
Good haul this month, mate. You'll see your cut.
Your share's on the barrel, mate.
Teeth out. Who's there?
Why are you watching me?
We know about your hands. Keep them still.
Early for your lessons, young one?
Your lessons begin at moonrise, young one.
Why are you out at night?
Visitors stare. Please do not.
Every one of us has heard what you did.
The array readings are good, neighbour.
We rest little here, neighbour.
Our lamps stay lit all night.
An offering has come to us.
Kneel and bare your throat, offering.
The fire has been fed well, offering.
The Razor Prince knows your work, offering.
An offering, after dark. The fire is lit.
Ask anything. Nothing leaves the shelves.
Grave-robber. That book stays.
Your shelf is untouched, reader.
The lamp is lit, reader.
Must it be now, reader?
Your licence, if you would.
Your conduct goes to the Grand Council.
Attendance noted. All is in order, attendant.
Shut the door behind you, attendant.
The First Adjunct is in conference.
Come about the fields, grower?
Get off our fields before I call the crew.
The first saltrice is cut, grower.
Rice again tonight, grower.
We're counting sacks. Mind the scales.
Your purse, soft-skin. Quickly.
Wardens know our camp now, soft-skin.
Back again, soft-skin? Then sit.
The fire is small, but warm.
Teeth in the grass. Keep moving.
Are you here for the names on the wall?
You did that in our hall, in front of the names.
Thank you for coming, witness.
A candle is lit for you, witness.
The vigil lasts all night, witness.
Root-sibling, or Warden spy?
Everyone here knows your face, informer.
By the unbound root, root-sibling.
Get inside, root-sibling. I'll bar the door.
The Veiled Reed take people at night, root-sibling.
No names, please. Not here.
You were never here. Understood?
Useful work lately, friend.
Night work suits you, friend.
Under the reed, friend. Speak softly.
Reed-folk? What brings you onto our stone?
Hands off our stone, Reed-folk.
The tree at Vakka-Bur has sap running, stone-kin.
The fire is ours, stone-kin.
Wandering at night? What is your road?
Yes? Say it.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n1
words: Need a mat for the night, traveller?
variants_low: Mats are for paying guests.
variants_high: Welcome back, traveller. Your mat is dry.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n1
words: You will sleep in the mud.
variants_low: Mud is your bed.
variants_high: Mud tonight. The roof is for honest guests.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n1
words: Your old mat is waiting, traveller.
variants_low: Your mat is taken.
variants_high: Your old mat is waiting. Sit, traveller.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n1
words: One dry mat remains.
variants_low: No mat tonight.
variants_high: I saved the dry one for you.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2-2
words: Mind the coils, ojel.
variants_low: Mind the coils.
variants_high: Come and look at the coils, ojel.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2-2
words: Keep away from my coils.
variants_low: Go away now.
variants_high: Leave my coils alone.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2-2
words: A good length today, ojel. Feel it.
variants_low: Not now, ojel.
variants_high: Pull on this one, ojel. It held.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2-2
words: Dark now. Work is done.
variants_low: No more talk tonight.
variants_high: Dark now, ojel. Sit a while.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2-3
words: Six jars filled, four to go.
variants_low: Jars first. Then talk.
variants_high: Seven filled already, traveller. Come and drink.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2-3
words: Leave the jars alone, thief.
variants_low: Stealing is it. Away.
variants_high: Put the jars down, traveller. We will say no more.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2-3
words: Back again, traveller. Have a cup. It is free.
variants_low: Oh. You.
variants_high: Back again, traveller. Drink before you go.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2-3
words: Asleep. Try me when the jars are out.
variants_low: Asleep. Away with you.
variants_high: Morning, traveller. I will pour you the first cup.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2-4
words: Pods, traveller? A supper on each throw.
variants_low: Not today, traveller.
variants_high: A supper on the next throw, traveller.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2-4
words: No game for thieves.
variants_low: Thieves do not throw.
variants_high: Put it right first, then we will throw.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2-4
words: That supper you owe me stands, traveller.
variants_low: You. The supper you owe stays owed.
variants_high: The supper you owe me can wait. Pods first.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2-4
words: Pods by firelight? I will wager a supper.
variants_low: Late for pods.
variants_high: Firelight suits pods. Roll.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2
words: Fed yet?
variants_low: Not hungry. Move.
variants_high: Fed yet? Bowl is ready.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2
words: You took from my pot, thief.
variants_low: Get away.
variants_high: Away, thief. Wasps can have you.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2
words: You came back to my pot.
variants_low: Pot is mine.
variants_high: Back to my pot. Lid is off for you.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n2
words: The coals are low.
variants_low: Coals are low. Off.
variants_high: Coals are low. Take the warm side.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n3
words: Hours of road left for me.
variants_low: Walk on past me.
variants_high: Ojel, sit and drink first.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n3
words: Your hand was in my pack.
variants_low: Touch my salt again and I shout.
variants_high: That is my salt. Ask first. I may share some.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n3
words: Come along at dawn.
variants_low: Walk alone. I do.
variants_high: Come along at dawn. I know the turns.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.n3
words: Dark now. I walk at dawn.
variants_low: Sleep or go.
variants_high: Dark now. Come along at dawn.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.root-herald
words: Your errand?
variants_low: State your errand or step aside.
variants_high: Your errand? Sit, then say it.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.root-herald
words: No trade for you now.
variants_low: No trade. Step away from my chest.
variants_high: No trade for you now. Pay what you owe first.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.root-herald
words: Your face I know. Good.
variants_low: My book is open. Enter your errand quickly.
variants_high: Your face I know. Sit by the chest.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.root-herald
words: Dark already. Say your errand.
variants_low: Too late for trade. Return tomorrow.
variants_high: Late for trade, but name your errand.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.spring-keeper
words: Cup first, visitor. Then we talk.
variants_low: Drink and go.
variants_high: Ah, visitor. The ladle's wet, so drink.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.spring-keeper
words: The ladle stays here.
variants_low: Hands off the cord.
variants_high: Lay the ladle on the stone, please.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.spring-keeper
words: You again, visitor. Drink, you know the taste by now.
variants_low: You are here again. Drink if you must.
variants_high: Back again, visitor. I filled the cold ladle already.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.spring-keeper
words: Cold comes off the pool after dark. Sip slowly.
variants_low: Late for a cup. Quick, then.
variants_high: Dark on the pool again. Sip it slowly with me.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.tree-minder
words: Walk softly, traveller. The tree is listening.
variants_low: Say your errand, traveller.
variants_high: Walk softly, traveller. Sit if you wish.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.tree-minder
words: Stand back from the tree, traveller.
variants_low: Back. Away from the tree.
variants_high: Stand back from the tree, traveller. We can talk away from it.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.tree-minder
words: Stay, root-kin. The leaves can wait a little.
variants_low: Root-kin. Speak briefly.
variants_high: Stay, root-kin. I have water for you.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.tree-minder
words: The root rests now. Return with the morning.
variants_low: The root is resting. Not tonight.
variants_high: The root rests now, root-kin. Return with the morning.

speaker: npc.hist-heartland.greenspring.tree-minder
words: You are back, root-kin. The root knows your step.
variants_low: You again, root-kin.
variants_high: You are back, root-kin. Sit by the root.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
words: Speak, ojel. The crews are listening.
variants_low: Not now. Off the pier.
variants_high: You are welcome here. Speak, I have time.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
words: The hulls have heard of it.
variants_low: Every crew saw. Leave the planks.
variants_high: I saw that, friend. Mend it before the vote.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
words: Fair water on your route, Compact blood.
variants_low: Fair water. Say it quickly.
variants_high: Fair water, friend. Ask me anything.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
words: The crews sleep below. Lower your voice, ojel.
variants_low: Night on the pier. Come at lamplight.
variants_high: Late, friend. Come in quietly.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.flotilla-speaker
words: Step aboard, ojel. The crews know you.
variants_low: Step aboard. Mind the rail.
variants_high: Step aboard, friend. My crews trust you.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
words: Out to the ships, passenger?
variants_low: No fare, no boat, passenger.
variants_high: Out to the ships, passenger? I will take you myself.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
words: Put it back before I call the speaker.
variants_low: Hands off the cargo.
variants_high: Put it back, passenger. I saw nothing.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
words: A guild man? Then take the tiller seat and sit easy.
variants_low: Guild or not, wait for the nod.
variants_high: A guild man, passenger? Take the tiller seat. I will fetch the lines.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
words: The next water turns near dawn.
variants_low: Nothing moves till dawn.
variants_high: Dawn, passenger. I will find you a place aboard.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman
words: Back at the pier? Mind the wet planks.
variants_low: Wet planks. Step careful.
variants_high: Back at the pier, passenger! The planks are wet, so mind your step.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
words: Stranger. You look light. No cargo today?
variants_low: Mind the lines. My hands are full.
variants_high: Stranger. You found the stage again.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
words: That cargo has an owner.
variants_low: Drop it.
variants_high: Put it down, stranger. I will say nothing this once.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
words: Late, stranger. The hulls are dark.
variants_low: Late. Off the planks.
variants_high: Late, stranger. Step softly past the foredeck.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-2
words: Come aboard, stranger. The planks are wet.
variants_low: Aboard, then. Be fast about it.
variants_high: Come aboard. Sit by the lines. The deep-water hands told me things.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
words: Visitor, my cup is not shared.
variants_low: Buy your own, visitor.
variants_high: Good day, visitor. Rafts pour fair today.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
words: Hands to yourself, visitor, or I shout.
variants_low: Off this deck, visitor.
variants_high: Careful, visitor. I saw that hand.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
words: Dark, visitor. Say it, then go.
variants_low: Dark and cold. Rye first, talk later.
variants_high: Dark out, visitor. Rest here a bit.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-3
words: Sit, ojel. I pour you one.
variants_low: You, ojel. One cup, then home.
variants_high: Sit, ojel. The good rye is yours.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
words: Landsman. Come to see the beetle?
variants_low: Not now, landsman. The lighter is loading.
variants_high: Landsman! He has been waiting for a visitor.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
words: That was not yours, landsman. Set it right.
variants_low: Set it back or I call the pier.
variants_high: Easy, landsman. Hand it over.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
words: Only the beetle is up now.
variants_low: Dark hour, landsman. Wake a neighbour.
variants_high: Awake too? Sit down and see his box.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1-4
words: Friend, come and meet the beetle.
variants_low: He is in the box. Look quickly.
variants_high: Come and meet him. He likes company.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
words: My heels are sore, friend. Ask quickly.
variants_low: My heels hurt. Speak or leave.
variants_high: Friend, sit on the rail. Ask me.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
words: That was theft. The speaker will hear.
variants_low: Off our planks.
variants_high: Friend, that is a bad turn. The speaker will hear.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
words: I cannot sleep. Too hot below.
variants_low: I am trying to sleep. Do not wake a hand off his turn.
variants_high: Friend, you are up late too. Ask quietly.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n1
words: My turn is done. Ask, friend.
variants_low: My turn is done. Hurry.
variants_high: Friend, my turn is done. Ask what you like.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
words: Mind the net on the deck, walker.
variants_low: Step wide of the net.
variants_high: Walker. Sit by the net, there is room.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
words: Hands off, ojel.
variants_low: Hands to yourself, ojel.
variants_high: Hands off that, walker. Ask me first.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
words: Still up, walker. The lamp is low.
variants_low: My needle wants the lamp. Walk softly.
variants_high: Still up, walker. Sit by the lamp while it lasts.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.n2
words: Stand by me, then. The net is no trouble to you.
variants_low: Stay clear of the net, ojel.
variants_high: Stand by me, walker. Take the stool. Take this end.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
words: Customer. Goods today, or a bunk?
variants_low: The counter is for buyers.
variants_high: Customer, good. I have something off the tariff line today.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
words: I have you in the book as owing.
variants_low: Pay what is written or leave.
variants_high: Settle the page and the line is gone.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
words: A Compact hand? Then I mark you in the book as ours.
variants_low: Compact or not, you pay like the rest.
variants_high: Compact hand! Your page in my book is clear.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
words: Bunks below, if you are tired.
variants_low: Bunks are paid before anyone sleeps.
variants_high: A bunk below is ready for you tonight.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.purser
words: Back again, customer. I laid out your goods.
variants_low: Goods are on the counter. Pay first.
variants_high: Customer, good to see you. I set the best aside.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n1
words: Name your load, walker.
variants_low: Stay off my bench.
variants_high: Up to the fire. Name it.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n1
words: You made trouble at my bench. Go.
variants_low: Off my fire, trouble-bringer.
variants_high: I remember your load. Say why.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n1
words: A fair load last time. Come ahead.
variants_low: You passed once. Do not lean on it.
variants_high: Your last stick was fair. Take the fire.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n1
words: Late, walker. What do you carry?
variants_low: Dark, yet walking. Name it.
variants_high: Late hour. Come to the fire.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-2
words: Racks are full of cured stock today. Look, buyer.
variants_low: No stock for you today.
variants_high: Come, buyer. The best rack is yours to see first.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-2
words: You robbed the band. Return the hide.
variants_low: You robbed the band. Drop the hide and walk.
variants_high: You robbed the band. Pay for the hide, buyer. Talk after.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-2
words: You bought well last time, buyer. More today?
variants_low: The last sale is done. Expect no favour.
variants_high: Back already, buyer. I set the best aside for you.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-2
words: Dark on the track. Come at first light.
variants_low: The racks are shut for the night.
variants_high: Dark, buyer. Come to the fire a while.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-3
words: Speak slowly, guest. I woke late.
variants_low: I am asleep, walker.
variants_high: Guest, take the warm side. I woke late but I will listen.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-3
words: You stole here. The band will hear.
variants_low: Thief. The band will hear.
variants_high: You stole here, guest. Put it right before the band hears.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-3
words: What news do you carry, guest?
variants_low: News? Say it fast.
variants_high: Guest, sit by the fire. What news?

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-3
words: The tent is for sleeping. Say it short.
variants_low: My turn is over. Leave me.
variants_high: Guest, step in and keep your voice low.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-4
words: Hands where I can see them, ojel.
variants_low: Walk, ojel. I have work.
variants_high: Welcome to the bench, ojel. Take the dry ground.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-4
words: Leave this post, ojel. You are done here.
variants_low: Out, ojel. Off this track.
variants_high: I expected better of you, ojel. Walk away.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-4
words: You again, ojel. The bend is quiet.
variants_low: Hurry past, ojel.
variants_high: Back so soon, ojel. A quiet bend today.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-4
words: Flint chips by the fire, ojel. Watch where you step.
variants_low: Chips on the ground. Walk round them, ojel.
variants_high: Come near the fire, ojel. The chips are swept aside.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-5
words: Two hundred paces off, I had you, walker.
variants_low: Walker. Say it short.
variants_high: Walker, I had you from far off. You are early.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-5
words: You took from the camp.
variants_low: Your hand was in our stores.
variants_high: You took from us, walker. Return it.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-5
words: I knew your walk across the pond.
variants_low: That walk again. Do not linger.
variants_high: Your walk, across the water. I am glad of it.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2-5
words: Black water tonight. I did not see you come.
variants_low: Not tonight, walker.
variants_high: Dark as the pond. I still marked you.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2
words: Walk up slowly, guest. The totems saw you.
variants_low: Stand off from the gate, walker.
variants_high: The totems and I are glad of you, guest.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2
words: No stick for that load. Leave this gate.
variants_low: Get off the track.
variants_high: You cut no stick for that load. Go back and answer for it.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2
words: The totems know your face, guest.
variants_low: Known or not, you wait at the gate.
variants_high: A known face, guest. The gate is open for you.

speaker: npc.naga-kur-deeps.naga-highway-camp-active-north.n2
words: You walk late. Halt at the gate.
variants_low: Turn back down the track.
variants_high: Late again, guest. Come up, the fire is lit.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
words: Who stands at the shed? Speak.
variants_low: State your business, then go.
variants_high: Off the road with you, walker. Sit awhile.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
words: You took from us. Climb away.
variants_low: Light fingers. Climb the terraces, now.
variants_high: You took from us. Climb away quietly.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
words: Round again. Sit by the fire.
variants_low: Round again. The pot is not for you.
variants_high: Round at last. Sit, eat, tell me the road.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-2
words: Late to walk. Fire is banked.
variants_low: Too late for visitors. Shoo.
variants_high: It is late, you. Come to the banked fire, quietly.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
words: Off the road. Was it clear?
variants_low: Pass the shed quickly. Its door stays shut to strangers.
variants_high: Down off the road at last. The pot is hot.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
words: Leave now, before the overseers come.
variants_low: Overseers soon. Leave quickly.
variants_high: Go quietly, walker. I will watch the path.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
words: You are back, walker.
variants_low: Back already. I have little time.
variants_high: You came back, walker. There is water.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-3
words: Dark road, walker. Which way did you come?
variants_low: Dark and late. Walk quickly.
variants_high: Come in to the fire, walker. The dark is long.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
words: New face on the slope. Ri'Sakka says welcome, friend.
variants_low: Ri'Sakka has reed to cut, friend. Not now.
variants_high: Welcome, friend. Ri'Sakka has dry reed for your seat.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
words: Ri'Sakka has heard. The families will hear.
variants_low: Ri'Sakka saw. Leave the mats.
variants_high: Ri'Sakka saw that, friend. Put it right before the families hear.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
words: Ri'Sakka sees you again, friend.
variants_low: Ri'Sakka has mats to mend. Speak quick.
variants_high: Friend! Ri'Sakka is glad of a face that pays.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-4
words: The reed is cut. Ri'Sakka is tired.
variants_low: Ri'Sakka is tired. Come at morning.
variants_high: Ri'Sakka is tired, friend, but sit a while by the fire.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
words: The water is up already, traveller.
variants_low: Out of the path, traveller.
variants_high: Traveller, sit. The first jar is still cool.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
words: Put back what you took. This one tallies the jars.
variants_low: Hands off the jars. They are tallied.
variants_high: Put it back and this one says nothing. The jars are tallied at dusk.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
words: A face that pays its way. The jars are full.
variants_low: The jars are full. Go and sit.
variants_high: A face that pays its way. Take a cup, walker.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1-5
words: Only embers now. Sleep well.
variants_low: Embers only. Go to bed.
variants_high: Only embers now, walker. Sleep well.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
words: Shift is done. Barge is tied.
variants_low: Mm. Late for shed talk.
variants_high: Fish heads are saved, if you are hungry.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
words: Leave it where it lies. Up the terraces.
variants_low: Terraces, now. Off my path.
variants_high: Leave it, friend. I will say nothing. Up the terraces.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
words: Our slope again. The pot is warm.
variants_low: Our slope. The pot is spoken for already.
variants_high: Our slope again. A bowl is waiting for you.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n1
words: Soft feet. The clutch is asleep.
variants_low: Soft feet. Take the long path.
variants_high: Soft feet, friend. The fire is low but kind.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
words: Business here, stranger, yes?
variants_low: Your business, or off with you.
variants_high: Welcome to the yard, stranger. Business or a visit?

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
words: Come with me.
variants_low: Put it down.
variants_high: Set it down. Come with me to the hut, stranger.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
words: You did as you said. The yard is open.
variants_low: You did as you said. Go ahead.
variants_high: You did as you said, stranger. Sit at the cookfire.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3-2
words: Doors are latched. Up to the road.
variants_low: Latched for the night.
variants_high: Doors are latched, stranger. Use the road till morning.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
words: Your name, walker. It goes in the book.
variants_low: Not at my fire.
variants_high: Your name, walker. I'll write it in a clean hand.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
words: I'm entering that at the full price.
variants_low: Full price. Pay or go.
variants_high: I'm entering that at the full price. Pay it down and we're square.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
words: Nothing against your name yet, outlander.
variants_low: Nothing against you yet.
variants_high: Still nothing against your name, outlander. I'm glad of it.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.n3
words: Two entries left to close. The lamp's low.
variants_low: Lamp's low. Tomorrow.
variants_high: Two entries left to close. Sit if you like, the lamp's low.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
words: Welcome, guest. The door shuts best with a push.
variants_low: Door. Shut it.
variants_high: Welcome, guest. The warmest spot is the nest wall.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
words: Get out. The eggs are not yours.
variants_low: Out. Go now.
variants_high: Out. I will not say it twice.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
words: Back again, guest. Come in to the warmth.
variants_low: Ah, you. Enter, then.
variants_high: Guest, welcome back. Come and sit by the warm wall.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-clutch-keeper
words: Softly, guest. The eggs are asleep.
variants_low: Soft. The eggs sleep.
variants_high: Softly, guest. Sit by the door if you like.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
words: Which family is yours?
variants_low: Wrong terrace for strangers. Leave us, please.
variants_high: Which family is yours, visitor? I can point you to any of them.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
words: Every family will know of this by dusk.
variants_low: I saw what you did. Do not ask me to forget it.
variants_high: Every family will know by dusk. I can tell you who saw, visitor.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
words: I know your face, visitor.
variants_low: Your face is known to me. That is no kindness.
variants_high: I know your face, visitor. Sit, the nets can wait.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.opening-work-camp.npc-opening-witness
words: The light is too poor for nets. Sit down if you like.
variants_low: Too dark to see your face. Stay on the planks.
variants_high: Too dark for nets now. Sit down, visitor. The cookfire is close.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1-2
words: Small, middling or good?
variants_low: Not buying? Then stand clear of the baskets.
variants_high: Good day to you. The good basket is the one by the fire.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1-2
words: You went for that basket. It is already sold.
variants_low: Leave the basket. It is sold.
variants_high: Hands off that basket. Ask me for another.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1-2
words: Late, buyer. The tenders are moored.
variants_low: The baskets are sold. Come at light.
variants_high: Late, buyer. Come at first light for the best.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1-2
words: Back again, buyer. Which basket today?
variants_low: Which basket, then?
variants_high: Back again, buyer. The middling ones are cheap today.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1-3
words: Up from the deep lot. Shore-foot.
variants_low: Wet, cold, tired. Say it now.
variants_high: Shore-foot. Sit by the fire, I am nearly dry.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1-3
words: Your hand was in a net that is not mine.
variants_low: That was a diver's net you handled.
variants_high: You handled a net I filled. Return it to the basket.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1-3
words: Night. The water is closed.
variants_low: Night. Keep off the lots.
variants_high: Night, shore-foot. The water opens at first light.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1-3
words: Rest here while I dry off.
variants_low: Stand there while I dry.
variants_high: Rest here, shore-foot. I will tell you the depth.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1-4
words: Mind the knife, asker.
variants_low: Back off, asker. I am cutting.
variants_high: Long breath to you, asker.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1-4
words: I have heard of it, asker.
variants_low: I saw it all, asker. Move off.
variants_high: I saw it, asker. Put it right.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1-4
words: No grading in the dark.
variants_low: The tally book is shut.
variants_high: The table is closed, but ask.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1-4
words: Watch this cut, asker.
variants_low: Stand there, asker.
variants_high: Closer, asker. Watch the knife.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1
words: Long breath, rower. What is your errand?
variants_low: Errand, rower.
variants_high: Long breath, rower. Come up to the fire.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1
words: Every family on the spit will hear of this.
variants_low: The spit will hear of this.
variants_high: The spit will hear of this. I will say what I can for you.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1
words: Dark. The lots are shut until work starts.
variants_low: Lots are shut. Leave the jetty.
variants_high: Dark, rower. The lots are shut. Come when the work starts.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n1
words: You are back at the raft.
variants_low: Back at the raft, are you.
variants_high: Back at the raft, rower. The lot kept your place.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n2
words: Mind the planks, boat-guest.
variants_low: Off the planks, boat-guest.
variants_high: Welcome aboard, boat-guest. The planks are dry.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n2
words: You cut a line. Get off my boat.
variants_low: A cut line. Leave my boat.
variants_high: You cut a line. Get off my boat.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n2
words: The divers are ashore for the night.
variants_low: The divers are ashore. Come back later.
variants_high: The divers are ashore. Come back at first light.

speaker: npc.saxhleel-coast.pearl-lots.n2
words: Back aboard, boat-guest. Lines are fair.
variants_low: Back, boat-guest. Touch nothing.
variants_high: Back aboard, boat-guest. Lines are fair today.

words: State your business. Briefly.
Your hands stay where I can see them.
Ah, it is you. Acceptable.
You may speak, since you are here.
I am working. Be brief.
Did the holder send you?
Please. Do not tell the holder.
The debtors talk of your kindness.
By my home tree, you are out at this hour?
My work is done. Speak, then.
Have you an appointment?
I have written your description down.
Ah. Welcome. I mean that, I think.
The last of the accounts. Please, sit.
The office is shut, but I am still here.
Need a boat? The post has three.
The factor's men are coming. Go, quickly.
Good water today. Where are you bound?
What do you need? The tide is turning.
We load at night. The ropes are out.
Ojel. A walker from another egg comes.
Hist piss. What you took is not yours.
Good day to come, ojel. The tide is out.
I extend the claw of greeting, ojel.
The tribe rests. Walk softly here.
What's it to be, Longshanks?
That's going in the tally, Longshanks.
Longshanks! Back from the deep marsh?
The frogs won't shut up. Sit if you like.
Who's that? Oh, it's you.
Good day. Is there something I might do?
I'll put a ward on you, I promise.
This house remembers your help, my friend.
Come in from the doorway, if you would.
It's dark, but perhaps I can spare a moment.
Address me as serjo.
Workers who run are brought back.
You have served the House well.
Sera, you may approach.
Speak quickly. My master sleeps.
What do you want?
I won't shout. I know your face now.
My door is open to you, sera.
Closing the books. Make it quick.
It is dark for callers from the road.
Is there a decent inn in this place?
I know people on the Tear road.
Sera. You're more civil than most here.
What now? My boxes are still open.
The insects are loud again, every night.
Halt. Name and business, friend.
Hand it over, or the serjeant hears of this.
You're always welcome at the post.
The brazier's warm till the roll is called.
Second watch. You're out late for the post.
My mill's by the sluice. Want something?
There is the thief from the mill.
I'd hoped you'd come. The flour's good this week.
Lock the door behind you, would you?
By Akatosh, I've only just shut the mill.
Do you know a dry road east?
Take it. I've nothing worth a fight.
A letter from home came today.
I've a broken cart wheel to mend.
It's too hot to sleep in this.
Walker has coin? I have goods.
This one will say nothing. Go, walker.
I kept the good rope for you, friend.
The lease is due. Buy something, friend?
The caravan leaves at first light. I am packing.
What does the walker want?
This one is leaving. Now.
Walker pays well. This one remembers.
The moons are bright. Talk with this one.
Another toll at the crossing. This one is nearly broke.
Blade oiled? The damp'll rust one in a week.
Shor's bones. Put it back.
Hold this while I quench it, will you?
There's mead on the bench if you're staying.
Forge is banked. What's wanted?
This swamp. I hate this swamp.
Do that again and you'll lose the hand.
Fancy a sparring bout? Fair fight.
Pirates pay better than the Charter.
Pay's late. Third month running.
Speak plainly, customer. I am busy.
No excuses. Out of my forge.
The blade is ready. Good work, that.
Pump the bellows if you are staying.
The iron came late. The forge stays hot.
Is the ferry running today?
I don't want trouble. You'd best go.
You're a sight. What d'you need?
Grandfather's sword. Want to see it?
Quiet night so far, friend.
Tar's still wet. Watch your feet.
Get off my slipway, hull-robber.
Come and look at this hull!
There's a wreck down the coast, I hear.
Caulking by lamplight. She'll launch tomorrow.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n1-2
words: Boat smell on you. Take the dry corner.
variants_low: Boat smell. Wipe your feet.
variants_high: Boat smell on you, guest. Sit, a bowl is going.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n1-2
words: Not under this roof.
variants_low: Get off my boards.
variants_high: Not under this roof, not from you.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n1-2
words: Rain on the step again. It still clings to you.
variants_low: Rain on you. Stay on the step.
variants_high: Rain on your shoulders. Come in and sit.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n1-2
words: Quietly. The herbs are drying overhead.
variants_low: Hush. Herbs are drying.
variants_high: Quietly, guest. Sit by the herbs. They smell sweet tonight.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n1-3
words: Sit, guest. Fish is in the pot.
variants_low: Sit if you must, guest.
variants_high: Sit, guest. Bring news for the pot.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n1-3
words: Out of my house. There is no bowl for you.
variants_low: Leave this house.
variants_high: Leave, guest. Come back settled.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n1-3
words: Guest! Sit and tell me the news.
variants_low: Sit, then.
variants_high: Guest! Come and eat. Fish tonight.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n1-3
words: The pot is empty, guest. Try tomorrow.
variants_low: Pot is empty. Come tomorrow.
variants_high: Pot is empty, guest. I have bread.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n1
words: Mud stays on the shore, ojel.
variants_low: You are late and dirty.
variants_high: Your last bed was left tidy.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n1
words: No bed in this house.
variants_low: The boards remember you.
variants_high: I cannot give you a bed.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n1
words: A dry bed is made.
variants_low: A bed is a bed.
variants_high: Your bed is turned and ready.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n1
words: Lamps are out. Take a bed.
variants_low: It is dark. Sleep quietly.
variants_high: Come inside. The reed is fresh.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n2-2
words: We are the Slow Heron. Mind my caps.
variants_low: Keep moving, pole-hand. Polish takes time.
variants_high: Slow Heron welcomes you. Come see the caps shine.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n2-2
words: Off the stage. I will fetch Lifts-Two-Traps.
variants_low: Off the stage, thief.
variants_high: Off the stage. I will fetch Lifts-Two-Traps.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n2-2
words: Slow Heron has time. Watch the copper shine.
variants_low: The cloth is busy, pole-hand.
variants_high: Sit, pole-hand. Watch the copper shine.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n2-2
words: You are late. Dark shut the crews' house.
variants_low: Dark shut that door hours past.
variants_high: You are late, pole-hand. Knock at the crews' house.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n2-3
words: Stones tonight, pole-hand? My luck is running.
variants_low: Not now, pole-hand. My throw is next.
variants_high: Pole-hand! Sit with me. I will teach you a throw.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n2-3
words: I play fair. You did not. Leave the bunk-house.
variants_low: Leave the bunk-house. I play fair, you do not.
variants_high: I hoped better of you, pole-hand. Leave the bunk-house.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n2-3
words: The bunk is still mine. Another round, pole-hand?
variants_low: The bunk is mine. Go on your way.
variants_high: Slow Heron's best friend! Pull up a mat.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n2-3
words: Quiet, please. I pole at dawn.
variants_low: Let me sleep. I am trying to rest.
variants_high: Quiet, friend. Come by at first light.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n2
words: You have the shoulders for a pole, ojel.
variants_low: Off the planks, ojel. They are narrow.
variants_high: Ojel with a good back! Sit by the raft a while.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n2
words: Off the stage now, or swim.
variants_low: Swim, then.
variants_high: Off the stage, please. I would hate to pole you out.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n2
words: Slow Heron! Sit a while on my board.
variants_low: Not now, ojel.
variants_high: Slow Heron! Sit and hum with me a while.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n2
words: Every bunk I know is taken. Try the crews' house.
variants_low: Full up. Find a bunk elsewhere.
variants_high: Full tonight. The crews' house may have a corner. Say I sent you.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n3-2
words: Pay at the post first, captain.
variants_low: Post first. Then talk.
variants_high: Pay at the post, captain. I will point you to the shelter after.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n3-2
words: You had your hands on the box, captain.
variants_low: Off the box.
variants_high: Hands off the box, captain. Step back from the post.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n3-2
words: Your last payment was clean. Pass, captain.
variants_low: You paid late last time. Wait here.
variants_high: Your last payment was clean, captain. Pass through and mind the soft boards.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n3-2
words: The box is locked for tonight.
variants_low: Box is locked. Return at light.
variants_high: The box is locked, captain. Return at light and I will weigh you first.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n3
words: I rang the chime. Go ahead, captain.
variants_low: The chime is rung. Say what you want.
variants_high: I rang the chime. Welcome, captain.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n3
words: Stay put. The toll-holder will hear of this.
variants_low: Stay where you are. Lifts-Two-Traps will hear of it.
variants_high: Stay put, captain. I would sooner not call the toll-holder.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n3
words: We know your name, captain.
variants_low: Your name is known. Mind the boards.
variants_high: We know your name, captain. The boards are yours.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.n3
words: The post shuts at dark. The ferry waits for light.
variants_low: The post is shut. Return at light.
variants_high: The post is shut, captain. The ferry sails at light.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.stage-mistress
words: Fed yet, traveller? No canoe sails with an empty passenger.
variants_low: You have not eaten. Eat, then ask.
variants_high: I extend the claw of welcome. Sit and eat first.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.stage-mistress
words: No canoe leaves for you.
variants_low: No fare taken. Away from my stage.
variants_high: Not today, traveller. Settle this, then come back.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.stage-mistress
words: Pilot, welcome. Did you eat today?
variants_low: Pilot. Fares first.
variants_high: Welcome back, pilot. Sit, there is food waiting.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.stage-mistress
words: The canoes sail at dawn. Eat, then sleep.
variants_low: The stage is shut until dawn.
variants_high: Rest well, traveller. Food, then bed. Canoes sail at dawn.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.toll-holder
words: Your boat's name, captain, for the slate.
variants_low: Name. Then go.
variants_high: Welcome back, captain. Your boat?

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.toll-holder
words: Stop here, captain. The slate stays with me.
variants_low: Hold there.
variants_high: Hold there, captain, please.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.toll-holder
words: You are in the column, captain.
variants_low: Paid. Pass.
variants_high: Paid and welcome, captain.

speaker: npc.dunmer-north.riverwalk.toll-holder
words: Moor for the night, captain.
variants_low: Moor. I write you at dawn.
variants_high: Moor safe, captain. Dawn entry.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.carrier
words: Mind the cloth, stranger.
variants_low: Not today, stranger.
variants_high: Stranger. Sit if you keep still.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.carrier
words: Hands off. I have heard of it.
variants_low: I watched that. Clear out.
variants_high: I watched that, friend. Hands off.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.carrier
words: Too dark to wrap now.
variants_low: The cloth waits till light.
variants_high: Too dark to wrap. Take the brazier.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.carrier
words: Help me tie these, then.
variants_low: Tie your own.
variants_high: Take the end of this cloth. Pull it tight.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.rose-family-2
words: Have you come to sit with my aunt, visitor?
variants_low: Not now, visitor.
variants_high: Sit, visitor. My aunt had room for company.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.rose-family-2
words: Not here, visitor, not near the dead.
variants_low: Outside, visitor. The dead are here.
variants_high: Not here, visitor. Take it outside.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.rose-family-2
words: One more night under this roof.
variants_low: Leave the night alone.
variants_high: Another night here. Sit by the brazier.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.rose-family-2
words: My aunt would have liked you.
variants_low: Hm. My aunt would not say.
variants_high: My aunt would have liked you a great deal.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.rose-family
words: You are standing in my doorway.
variants_low: Move from my doorway.
variants_high: You may stand in my doorway, visitor.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.rose-family
words: In the Rose, we would answer that.
variants_low: The Rose will hear of this.
variants_high: I will not speak of it, visitor.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.rose-family
words: Who walks up here at night, visitor?
variants_low: Go back down, visitor.
variants_high: Come to the brazier, visitor. It is late.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.rose-family
words: You have been patient with us, visitor.
variants_low: Patient, perhaps. Stand there.
variants_high: You have been patient with us, visitor. Stay by the brazier.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.tag-keeper
words: Have you come for one of the dead?
variants_low: Wait. The line is half written.
variants_high: Step under the shelter. Say which body you seek.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.tag-keeper
words: That goes in the book too.
variants_low: I will write that down.
variants_high: I would sooner not write that. I will.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.tag-keeper
words: Still writing here, friend. Come closer.
variants_low: It is late. I am writing. Wait.
variants_high: Still at the book, friend. Come in by the brazier.

speaker: npc.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation.tag-keeper
words: Ask me about the charges, friend.
variants_low: Charges. Ask quickly.
variants_high: Ask me the charges, friend. I will show you the book.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n1
words: The bell has sounded twice. Speak, seeker.
variants_low: Two strokes. Say it fast.
variants_high: Two strokes sounded, seeker. Speak, you are welcome.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n1
words: The temple is shut to you.
variants_low: Leave the bank.
variants_high: The temple is shut to you. I am sorry for it.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n1
words: You are back, seeker. I hoped you would be.
variants_low: It is you again.
variants_high: You are back, seeker. I hoped so. Sit by the lamp.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n1
words: The band sleeps. Keep to a whisper.
variants_low: Sleepers lie close. Be silent.
variants_high: The band sleeps, seeker. Speak low, I will hear you.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2-2
words: The top step is mine. Offerings first, words after.
variants_low: Off my step.
variants_high: Climb. Show me the offering, then ask what you like.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2-2
words: Leave, before I call the band.
variants_low: Go down the way.
variants_high: Leave now. I will say nothing to the band.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2-2
words: You again. Fine.
variants_low: Not today.
variants_high: Still coming. Fine, climb, but softly.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2-2
words: Off the stair. Wake a priest if you must.
variants_low: Lower your voice on my stair.
variants_high: Walk soft. The band is asleep.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2-3
words: A pilgrim. You came up alone?
variants_low: Stay off the stair until you are asked.
variants_high: Friend, mind the wet stone on the way up.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2-3
words: You tried the stair unasked. Not again.
variants_low: Get down from my stair.
variants_high: I will let it pass this once. Ask me first next time.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2-3
words: I counted your steps up from the landing, friend.
variants_low: I saw you come up. Say your business.
variants_high: I counted you all the way up, friend. Ask me what you need.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2-3
words: Late for a pilgrim, friend. Stay where I can see you.
variants_low: Come back in the day. The stair is mine now.
variants_high: Friend, you are late. Stand by the lamp.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2-4
words: That bowl in your hands, giver?
variants_low: Empty hands?
variants_high: A good bowl, giver.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2-4
words: Nothing leaves this temple.
variants_low: Return it to the stone.
variants_high: Put it back, giver. I will say no more.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2-4
words: You look well.
variants_low: Pilgrim, step aside.
variants_high: You look well. Your bowl is safe with me.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2-4
words: Dark on the landing. Come back at dawn.
variants_low: Go back. The landing is shut.
variants_high: Dark on the landing, giver. Dawn is better.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2
words: Keep your voice low, stranger. The rite runs.
variants_low: The rite runs. Not for you.
variants_high: Welcome, stranger. You picked a quiet hour.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2
words: You took that, stranger.
variants_low: Put the thing down. I am watching.
variants_high: I saw that, stranger. Return it and I will say nothing.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2
words: A good hour to you, stranger.
variants_low: Speak, then, or pass.
variants_high: A good hour, stranger. It is a pleasure to have you here.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.n2
words: Night watch. My legs know the water's colder.
variants_low: Night watch. Leave me to it.
variants_high: Night watch. Stay a while if the dark suits you.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.nisswo-teeth
words: What offering do you carry, pilgrim?
variants_low: Show your offering or turn back.
variants_high: Welcome, pilgrim. What offering do you bring?

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.nisswo-teeth
words: I will take no gift from you.
variants_low: Away from the water. I take no gift from you.
variants_high: I will take no gift from you. Say what you must.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.nisswo-teeth
words: You come again, pilgrim. Ask your question.
variants_low: Again. Ask, then go.
variants_high: You return, pilgrim. Ask what you came to ask.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.nisswo-teeth
words: The day's rite is finished.
variants_low: The rite is done. Walk back up the track.
variants_high: The rite is finished for today, pilgrim. Come when the lamps go out.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.the-one
words: Tide is high, traveller.
variants_low: Tide is high. Mind the edge.
variants_high: Tide is high, traveller. Good day for the brush.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.the-one
words: Keep away from me.
variants_low: Keep away.
variants_high: Keep away from me, traveller. I mean it.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.the-one
words: Clean stone today, traveller. Look.
variants_low: Clean stone. Do not touch it.
variants_high: Clean stone today, traveller. Look how it shines above the line.

speaker: npc.mercantile-coast.teeth-of-sithis.the-one
words: Cold comes off the sea tonight.
variants_low: Cold tonight. Go inside.
variants_high: Cold comes off the sea tonight, traveller. Keep your cloak shut.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n1
words: State your business on this track, citizen.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n1
words: The book has this. Stand there while I check it.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n1
words: The watch is set. Speak from where you stand.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n1
words: Back again, citizen.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n2-2
words: It's two watches since the last traveller.
variants_low: I'm on watch. Keep walking.
variants_high: It's two watches since a traveller, sir. Come up.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n2-2
words: You are the thief. The serjeant will hear.
variants_low: Touch it and the serjeant wakes.
variants_high: Hands off that, friend! Serjeant will hear.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n2-2
words: It's quiet. Try the fire.
variants_low: Quiet. Leave me be.
variants_high: It's quiet, sir. Try the fire.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n2-2
words: It's you again. The sky's been quiet.
variants_low: Here once more. Levy first.
variants_high: You again, sir. The sky's been quiet.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n2-3
words: Stop there, citizen. I'm cooking.
variants_low: Not now, citizen. I've a pot to mind.
variants_high: Come to the fire, citizen. Mind the pot.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n2-3
words: Leave that sack. It's tomorrow's supper.
variants_low: Put it down, or I fetch the serjeant.
variants_high: Leave that sack, friend. I'll share it out.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n2-3
words: The fire's banked. Breakfast is barley.
variants_low: Fire's banked. Go away till morning.
variants_high: The fire's banked, but there's barley going.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n2-3
words: Back so soon, citizen? The levy's still due.
variants_low: Levy first, citizen. The pot won't wait.
variants_high: Sit, citizen. The pot's warm.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n2
words: State your business, traveller. Levy first.
variants_low: Levy first, traveller.
variants_high: Welcome, traveller. Levy, then your business.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n2
words: Serjeant, here is the one the book names.
variants_low: Hold. Serjeant!
variants_high: Hold, you! Serjeant, turn out the watch! Give yourself up.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n2
words: Barricade's closed till the morning watch.
variants_low: Closed till morning.
variants_high: Closed till morning watch, traveller. Try at light.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.the-broke-column.n2
words: You paid in full before. I know the face.
variants_low: Paid before. On with you.
variants_high: Paid in full last time. The fire's open.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.upriver-hist-village.hh-dyer
words: Wet to the elbow. Mind the vat.
variants_low: Mind the vat. Keep your distance.
variants_high: Welcome to the vat house, visitor. Mind the wet floor.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.upriver-hist-village.hh-dyer
words: The elder will hear of this theft.
variants_low: The elder will hear of this.
variants_high: The elder will hear of this theft. Return the stolen thing, visitor.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.upriver-hist-village.hh-dyer
words: Late, visitor. Did the bends treat you well?
variants_low: The vat is covered for the night.
variants_high: Visitor, you are late. The bends run long in the dark.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.upriver-hist-village.hh-dyer
words: The cutter asked after you this morning.
variants_low: The cutter asked about you.
variants_high: The cutter asked after you this morning. Step closer, visitor.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.upriver-hist-village.hh-net-menders
words: Mind the rack, mate. Three hundred knots here.
variants_low: Off my rack.
variants_high: Mind the rack, mate. Sit if the knots do not trouble you.

speaker: npc.pirate-freeholds.upriver-hist-village.hh-net-menders
words: Your hand went in my basket. The elder will hear.
variants_low: The elder hears of this.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: Claywater Station is a mixed village where the road crosses the Claywater ford. An Imperial well and station house stand on one bank. Our landing stands on the other. The landing is older than the station. Two languages are spoken here, one from each bank.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: Gideon is one of the two names on the signpost at Cartwright's Cross, east of the station. Gideon has the last working courthouse. A signed paper settles things there. Here a quarrel goes to the poler on our bank and to the well-keeper on the other.
variants_low: Gideon is east, past Cartwright's Cross.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: I pole this ford, traveller. Helstrom is not a place I can speak of. Ask Abhuki or Mee-Seesh, the road travellers at the station. I can tell you of the ford, the raft and the road to Cartwright's Cross.
variants_low: I pole this ford. Ask elsewhere about Helstrom.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: It is the river at my ford. I pole it every morning. I know the ford better than the river's length. The ford is shallow and stony, so a walker can wade it and a cart cannot.
variants_low: It is the river at my ford.
variants_high: It is the river at my ford, traveller. I pole it every morning. I know the ford better than the river's length. The ford is shallow and stony, so a walker can wade it and a cart cannot. That is why carts need my raft.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: I do not know that road, traveller. The road I can speak of is the Blackwood Road, which crosses the ford here. Ask Abhuki or Mee-Seesh, the road travellers at the station.
variants_low: I do not know that road. Ask elsewhere.
variants_high: I do not know that road, friend. The road I can speak of is the Blackwood Road, which crosses the ford here. Ask Abhuki or Mee-Seesh, the road travellers at the station.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: The landing digs its plaster clay at the cut below the ford, on the station bank, as we did before the well. From the well, go about 45 yards west, outside the low stone walls, to where the river swings west under a bare clay bank and the water lies deep and dark. If the bank flattens into reeds, you have gone past it. A crocodile has the deep pool under the cut and comes up at whoever stands on it. The landing has not dug for ten days. Our basket lies there. How it came to lie there is not for strangers. The rains are close. The landing will hear terms from whoever gives it back its cut before them. Ask Takes-The-Short-Weight, who tastes everything, what ails the station's water. She lives in the round mud hut on our bank, about 30 yards north of the raft. In the morning she sits at the landing's fire, about 50 yards north of the raft.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: Claywater Station is two halves at one ford. The station has its well and its house on one bank. The landing has the raft and the huts on the other. Neither half can hold the other's bank. The landing is older. We are proud of the ford.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler

words: Livia Varinius is dead, traveller. The station's charge ended with her. The landing's charge stands on the ford. I have little heart to talk of it.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: No stone, ever. Mortar cracks with the moving bank and lets the ford in. Clay rammed behind a wall bends with the bank and keeps the ford out. We renew it each dry season, when we renew our walls. One charge would be two drakes a stop, one drake to each bank. The landing's drake would pay for the clay. But there is no clay until the basket is back from the cut. The rains are close. I set the walkers' charge when the station raised its own. Takes-The-Short-Weight told me the walkers' charge is wrong, because travellers wade past the crocodile at night to avoid it. I would not hear it.
variants_low: No stone, ever. We ram clay behind any wall on this bank. It bends with the bank and keeps the ford out. One charge of two drakes a stop, one drake to each bank, would do it. variants_high: Listen, friend, because this is the landing's whole offer. No stone, ever. Mortar cracks with the moving bank and lets the ford in. I set the walkers' charge when the station raised its own. Takes-The-Short-Weight told me the walkers' charge is wrong, because travellers wade past the crocodile at night to avoid it. I would not hear it. I wish I had.

words: The station only wants stone. The landing will not haul it. Mortar cracks with the moving bank. Clay does not. Show me this is a crack that clay seals. Look at the well. Ask Takes-The-Short-Weight, who tastes everything. I do not give the landing's clay on a stranger's word.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler
words: A cart crosses the ford on my plank raft. Carts pay by the wheel. Walkers can wade the ford, which is shallow and stony. This season they pay one drake a head to do it. I pole in the morning and work the racks in the afternoon.
variants_low: A cart crosses on my plank raft. Carts pay by the wheel.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.landing-s-poler

words: I know the ford. I know where it can be waded. Of the river beyond it I can tell you little. Ask at the landing. They work the water.

variants_high: I know the ford. I know where it can be waded. Of the river beyond it I can tell you little. Ask at the landing. They work the water. They are good neighbours.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.well-keeper
words: Past Cartwright's Cross the signpost arms point to Gideon and to Leyawiin. Of the road beyond that I know no more. I keep the well.

variants_high: Past Cartwright's Cross the signpost arms point to Gideon and to Leyawiin. Of the road beyond that I know no more. I keep the well. I am sorry to disappoint you.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.well-keeper
words: Two halves at one ford. Neither can hold the other's bank. My side is stone and old timber. The landing is mud and thatch.
variants_low: Two halves at one ford. Neither can hold the other's bank.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.well-keeper
words: A crocodile lies in the deep pool under the clay cut below the ford, where the landing digs its plaster clay. It suns on the bank at midday. It comes up at any traveller on it, day or night. Keep away from it after dark.

I suspect some travellers wade the shallow tail of the river below it at night to dodge the landing's charge.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.well-keeper

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.well-keeper
words: You have found the yearly mending, then. Very well. The lining has cracked every year. Each dry season I have re-mortared it myself. It has not held. A mason's proper lining in stone will hold where my mortar did not. Say what you mean to do about the station's charge.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.well-keeper

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.claywater-station.well-keeper

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.bog-iron-workings.n1-2
words: Blackwood is the hill country out west in Black Marsh. A road climbs up through the hills into Cyrodiil. I haven't walked it. The hill people stay close to the roots of their own tree and don't ask after strangers. They'll stop for a riddle though.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.bog-iron-workings.n1-2
words: Bog iron is iron the marsh makes itself. Water works down through the clay and leaves a hard crust of iron in its place. We cut that crust into cakes. Then we smelt the cakes in the clay furnace on the bench. The workings lie below the road.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.bog-iron-workings.n1-2
words: Ojel is what we call outsiders. There's no insult in it, so say it freely. You are ojel to me and to everyone at this furnace. Lukiul is another matter. The An-Xileel coined it as a slur for our kind who hatched beyond Black Marsh. They cannot hear the Hist.
variants_low: Ojel is outsiders. No insult in it. Lukiul is the An-Xileel slur for Argonians hatched beyond Black Marsh, who cannot hear the Hist.
variants_high: Ojel is what we call outsiders. There's no insult in it, so say it freely. Lukiul is another matter. I'd keep that word behind your teeth. The An-Xileel coined it as a slur for our kind who hatched beyond Black Marsh. They cannot hear the Hist.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.bog-iron-workings.n1-2
words: The Empire laid the Prison road and the Border road. It built the Mile House as a waystation. The old ones say those roads rotted the cargo. People still use the old names. The Prison road heads for the Rose. You will find the Tag House at its side, up on a dry rise.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.bog-iron-workings.n1-2
words: A place? It's a seep in the ferns with a bench above it. Iron comes up out of the mud in cakes. We smelt them in the clay furnace up top. I work the bellows there from first light. The air smells of sulphur and the mud makes a sucking sound all day. I leave when the season does.
variants_low: It's a seep and a furnace. Dig, smelt, leave.
variants_high: It's a seep in the ferns with a bench above it. Iron comes out of the mud in cakes. We smelt them in the clay furnace up top. I'm on the bellows there from first light. Come to the bench in the morning and I'll let you feel the heat. The sulphur you will smell whatever I do.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.bog-iron-workings.n1-2
words: Danger? The leeches are the small trouble. They fill the seep and you pick them off after. The deep end is the real one. We gave it up, because something sits in the pools down there. From the bellows at dusk I hear it move. I was right about that long before the others would say so. The mud near the path has given what it had. Cakes lie farther out now. They come up small.
variants_low: Leeches in the seep. Something in the deep end. Stay out of the pools.
variants_high: The leeches are the small trouble. They fill the seep, so check your legs. The deep end is the real one. We gave it up, because something sits in the pools down there. From the bellows at dusk I hear it move. Be gone before dark, visitor. The cakes lie farther out now. They come up small.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.bog-iron-workings.n1-2
words: I only know the road as far as the top of the path. The path up from the bench meets the road at the top. Others turn west there and come to Mile House of the Eagle, with Cartwright's Cross after it. I haven't walked that far. I'm at the furnace all day.
variants_low: Up the path to the road. West after that. I haven't gone farther.
variants_high: I only know the road as far as the top of the path. It meets the road at the top. Turn west there and you come to Mile House of the Eagle, with Cartwright's Cross after it. I haven't walked that far myself. Go up before the light goes and you'll make the Mile House by dark.

speaker: npc.imperial-fringe.bog-iron-workings.n1-2
words: Three of us were hired from three villages. Prices-The-Salvage keeps the count and sleeps by the stacked cakes. He sees no shame in it, since he's paid by the stack. Meets-Every-Tide wades for the iron. I work the bellows and feel the shame of it more than they do. We leave once the season is done.
